April 2017 - Moscow, Russia: Russia-24 news legend [Tatiana Stolyarova](https://i.sli.mg/aZEEth.jpg) reporting.

Russian Deputy Defense Minister [Anatoly Antonov](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/SO6_CEzfulU/maxresdefault.jpg) has issued this years formal invitations to the 2017 International Army Games. The [International Army Games](http://sputniknews.com/military/20150801/1025292141.html) are a global phenomenon that have recently become exceedingly popular throughout Russia and several other key nations. Each year, armies from across the world pack their gear and vehicles and head to Russia to participate in a series of challenging and rewarding games. In some competitions, Russian equipment and vehicles will be provided for countries who cannot provide or transport their own. Certain events, such as any aircraft-related challenges, will obviously disallow other armies from competing with Russian-supplied vehicles. There will be exceptions to this case for close allies who own, operate and maintain those vehicles at an expert level in their home country.

Some of the exciting events that will be televised and live-streamed on the internet include:

* [Tank Biathlons.](https://www.rt.com/news/312560-army-games-russia-tank-biathlon/) [M] How awesome is this? [/M] * [Aviadarts will show who masters percision flight and accuracy](http://foxtrotalpha.jalopnik.com/incredible-aerial-footage-from-russias-aviadarts-exerci-1617018839) * [Masters of Air Defense](http://sputniknews.com/russia/20150802/1025313784.html) * Masters of Artillery Fire. * Most Accurate Aerial Bombardment * Sniper Games * Challenges for Divers * Military Engineers will have to bring their best problem solving skills onto a "live" battle field * What nations have the best Paratroopers? * What random challenge will the [Sappers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sapper) be given? * What will your Military Chemists cook up? * What will your Army Cooks literally cook up?

Two brand new categories are being introduced this year:

* Offensive/Defensive Shovelling * Field Medic Response Tests! If any soldiers are injured by accident on the play field during the entirety of the games, be on your toes to patch them up!

The games will be held across at least 20 locations throughout Russia, [Kazakhstan](http://sputniknews.com/military/20160205/1034277770/russia-army-games-kazakhstan.html) and the Black and Caspian seas. There are rumors that the Russian Defense Minister is working with Belarus in setting up at least 1 competition to occur within their borders for the first time this year. Belarus is a long-standing ally and is [one of only three nations who competes in the incredible Aviadarts competition](http://foxtrotalpha.jalopnik.com/incredible-aerial-footage-from-russias-aviadarts-exerci-1617018839).

Several of the [previous attending countries](http://sputniknews.com/military/20150801/1025292141.html) are being invited to compete this year. Those countries include Azerbaijan, Angola, Armenia, Belarus, China, Egypt, India, Kazakhstan, Kuwait, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Nicaragua, Pakistan, Serbia, Tajikistan and Venezuela. Nations who were [formally invited as observers](http://sputniknews.com/russia/20150802/1025313784.html) are being invited and encouraged to participate. These countries include Iran, Vietnam, Myanmar and Turkmenistan.

It's no secret that the "Offensive/Defensive Shovelling" event was created due to the overwhelming response to the [care package Russia sent the island nation of Tuvalu last year](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/986936). We welcome them with open arms to these competitions to compete in any event the nation of Tuvalu can! We are sure several nations would be willing to loan and train Tuvalu how to use a variety of weapons for different events. Some nations may even allow Tuvulan soldiers to join their teams in order to 'learn the ropes' per-se.
